title: 開いた入口付き写真ブース
description: 駅や商業施設の通路に置く、自立型の無銘写真ブース。前面には入室できる空いた開口と片側に寄せた厚みのあるカーテンがあり、内部に台座付き座席・背当て、向かい合う固定カメラと不透明な画面、外側に無記載の操作面と空の出力口、背面に貫通換気スリットを造形。画面・レンズ・照明面は不透明かつ非発光です。撮影、印刷、支払、カーテン操作は未実装。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.839 × 2.175 × 1.345 m、8,892三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding unbranded photo booth for station and shopping-center corridors. Its front has a genuinely open entrance and thick gathered curtain at one side, with a pedestal seat/backrest, opposing fixed camera and opaque display inside, blank exterior controls, an empty output mouth, and through ventilation slots at the rear. Display, lens and lighting faces are opaque and non-emissive. Photography, printing, payment and curtain motion are not implemented. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.839 × 2.175 × 1.345 m; 8,892 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
